name: Vile Reef
summary: Murlocs guard Vile Reef beneath the Great Sea, just off Stranglethorn Vale near Grom'gol Base Camp. Coral, troll ruins, shipwrecks, and giant clams fill its waters.

sections.title: Sunken Stones and Coral Beds
sections.body: Beneath the Great Sea, Vile Reef lies just offshore from Grom'gol Base Camp. Vivid coral grows across the seabed beside weathered troll ruins and the Altar of the Tides. Territorial murlocs lurk among the coral and shattered ship timbers. They defend the shallows and prey on divers seeking giant clams and rare blue pearls.

faq.q: Where is the Vile Reef located?
faq.answer: Vile Reef lies in the Great Sea off Stranglethorn Vale's western shore, directly northwest of Grom'gol Base Camp.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Vile Reef?
faq.answer: Hostile murlocs swim among the coral and sunken structures. Giant clams rest on the sea floor.

faq.q: What ruins are found underwater here?
faq.answer: Ancient troll ruins and the Altar of the Tides lie on the sea floor, remnants of troll civilization swallowed by the ocean.

faq.q: Why do adventurers dive into the Vile Reef?
faq.answer: Divers brave the murlocs to explore shipwrecks, investigate the Altar of the Tides, and harvest giant clams that may conceal precious blue pearls.

angles.text: Just offshore from Grom'gol Base Camp, Vile Reef remains a maritime threat to Horde supply vessels and coastal patrols in Stranglethorn Vale.
The sunken stones and Altar of the Tides recall the long-lost coastal territory once commanded by the jungle trolls.
